name: EDCI 3214
title: Introduction to Secondary Methods and Clinic: Social Studies
description: Introduction to the teaching and learning of social studies. The social studies include many disciplines such as history, political science/government/civics, geography, economics, and others. The focus will be on the discipline of history - the heart of the social studies curriculum - but time is also spent on civics, geography, and economics, and on an inquiry approach to teaching.
requirement_description: Open only to secondary History/Social Studies Education students in the Integrated Bachelor's/Master's Teacher Preparation Program.
